records.jp: あれ、これってピアノの音？<CR>誰か弾いてるの？
records.en_original: Is that piano I hear? Is somebody playing?
records.en_auxiliary: Is that piano I hear? Is somebody playing?
records.en: Huh, is that a piano?<CR>Is someone playing?

records.jp: こんなにきれいな音色、初めて聞いた気がする
records.en_original: I don't think I've ever heard piano this beautiful...
records.en_auxiliary: I don't think I've ever heard piano this beautiful...
records.en: I don't think I've ever heard such a beautiful tone before...

records.jp: だめ！　こんなのじゃ全然だめ！
records.en_original: No! This is all garbage!
records.en_auxiliary: No! This is all garbage!
records.en: No! This is no good at all!

records.jp: な、なに？　びっくりした……
records.en_original: Wh-Whoa! That startled me.
records.en_auxiliary: Wh-whoa! That startled me.
records.en: Wh-What? That startled me...

records.jp: これじゃだめ……まったく思いどおりの音が出せない
records.en_original: I'll never be able to play what's in my head like this...
records.en_auxiliary: I'll never be able to play what's in my head like this...
records.en: This won't do... I can't produce the sound I want at all.

records.jp: どうしよう、このままだと発表会で大恥をかいちゃう……。<CR>なんで、どうして……私の何がいけないの
records.en_original: I'm gonna completely embarrass myself at the recital. <CR>I just don't get it... What's wrong with me?
records.en_auxiliary: I'm gonna completely embarrass myself at the recital.<CR>I just don't get it... What's wrong with me?
records.en: What am I going to do? At this rate, I'll embarrass myself at the recital...<CR>Why? What am I doing wrong?

records.jp: えっと
records.en_original: Um...
records.en_auxiliary: Um...
records.en: Um...

records.jp: えっ？
records.en_original: Eh?
records.en_auxiliary: Eh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: な、なに？　知らない人が、じっとこっちを見てる。<CR>すごく怖いんだけど
records.en_original: What's going on here? There is a stranger staring right at me! It's kinda freakin' me out here.
records.en_auxiliary: What's going on here? There's a stranger staring right at me! It's kind of freaking me out.
records.en: Wh-What? A stranger is staring right at me.<CR>This is really scary.

records.jp: でもそういうこと表立って言うと揉めそうだし、<CR>ここは平静を装って「どなた様？」と聞くべきかしら
records.en_original: But if I come on too aggressive, it might end in a brawl. I should pretend to be calm and ask her, "Who might you be?"
records.en_auxiliary: But if I say that, it might cause trouble. I should pretend to be calm and ask her, "Who might you be?"
records.en: But saying that out loud could cause trouble,<CR>so maybe I should act calm and ask, "Who are you?"

records.jp: 全部口に出てる……
records.en_original: Um, you're thinking out loud...
records.en_auxiliary: Um, you're thinking out loud...
records.en: She's saying all of that out loud...

records.jp: どなた様？
records.en_original: Who might you be?
records.en_auxiliary: Who might you be?
records.en: Who might you be?

records.jp: ごり押しした……。いいけど
records.en_original: And she just keeps going... Well, whatever.
records.en_auxiliary: And she just keeps going... Well, whatever.
records.en: She just pushed right through that... Well, fine.

records.jp: 私は白井日菜子。普通科の１年。<CR>あなたは？
records.en_original: I'm Hinako Shirai. I'm a first year in the general education program. <CR>How about you?
records.en_auxiliary: I'm Hinako Shirai. I'm a first-year in the regular class.<CR>How about you?
records.en: I'm Shirai Hinako, a first-year in the Regular Class.<CR>And you?

records.jp: 私は……多谷史緒。特待科の１年よ。<CR>よろしくね
records.en_original: I'm... Fumio Taya. A first year in the special education program. <CR>Pleasure to meetcha.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm...Fumio Taya. A first-year in the special class.<CR> Pleasure to meet you.
records.en: I'm... Taya Fumio, a first-year in the Special Class.<CR>Nice to meet you.

records.jp: 同じ１年生だったんだ。こちらこそよろしく。<CR>特待ってもしかして……ピアノの？
records.en_original: Oh, nice to meet another first year. I imagine you're in the special program for...piano?
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, nice to meet another first-year. I imagine you're in the special class for...piano?
records.en: So we're both first-years. Nice to meet you too.<CR>Are you in the Special Class for...piano?

records.jp: うん……あ、今の演奏聞いてたんだ。<CR>ひょっとして声も聞こえちゃってた？
records.en_original: I take it you were listening to me just now. Did you hear me talking to myself, too?
records.en_auxiliary: Yes. Oh, I take it you were listening to me just now. Did you hear me talking to myself, too?
records.en: Yeah... Oh, so you heard me playing just now.<CR>Did you hear what I was saying too?

records.jp: うん。素人の私でもきれいな音色だと思ったから、<CR>別に自信持っていいんじゃない？
records.en_original: I did, but you should have more confidence! I'm not an expert, but what you were playing sounded wonderful!
records.en_auxiliary: I did, but you should have more confidence! I'm not an expert, but what you were playing sounded wonderful!
records.en: Yeah. Even to an amateur like me, it sounded beautiful,<CR>so I think you can have a little more confidence.

records.jp: このくらい、当然だよ。<CR>少し練習すれば誰でも弾ける曲だし
records.en_original: It's really nothing. Anyone could play that song with a little practice.
records.en_auxiliary: It's really nothing. Anyone could play that song with a little practice.
records.en: This is nothing special.<CR>Anyone could play this piece with a little practice.

records.jp: 逆に今のままじゃ発表会、失敗するかも……
records.en_original: If I don't get any better, I'm bound to crash and burn at this recital.
records.en_auxiliary: If I don't get any better, I'm bound to crash and burn at this recital.
records.en: At this rate, I might fail at the recital...

records.jp: そうなんだ
records.en_original: Wow...
records.en_auxiliary: Wow...
records.en: I see.

records.jp: （その道のプロじゃないとわからない世界ってやつかな）
records.en_original: (I guess pros hold themselves to higher standards...)
records.en_auxiliary: (I guess pros hold themselves to higher standards...)
records.en: (I guess this is a world only professionals understand...)

records.jp: 必要なものはもうわかっているの
records.en_original: I know exactly what I need, though.
records.en_auxiliary: I know exactly what I need, though.
records.en: I know exactly what I need, though.

records.jp: へぇ？　そうなの？
records.en_original: Really? What is it?
records.en_auxiliary: Really? What is it?
records.en: Oh? You do?

records.jp: 緊張感……ひりつくような熱気と<CR>切迫感、そして昂揚
records.en_original: I need...tension. Burning enthusiasm and overwhelming urgency that finally gives way to blissful ecstasy.
records.en_auxiliary: I need...tension. Burning enthusiasm and overwhelming urgency that finally gives way to blissful ecstasy.
records.en: Tension...searing intensity,<CR>a sense of urgency, and exhilaration.

records.jp: ……どういうこと？
records.en_original: ...Simplify that for me?
records.en_auxiliary: ...Simplify that for me?
records.en: ...What do you mean?

records.jp: あえて言うなら――デスマね
records.en_original: One could call it...a death march.
records.en_auxiliary: One could call it...a death march.
records.en: If I had to name it—a death march.

records.jp: ですま？
records.en_original: That doesn't really help.
records.en_auxiliary: Death march?
records.en: A death march?

records.jp: 私のお父さんＩＴ企業のＳＥやっていて、<CR>納期寸前の修羅場話をいつもしてくれるの
records.en_original: My dad works in the IT industry as a software engineer, and <CR>he's told me a million horror stories about crunch.
records.en_auxiliary: My dad works in the IT industry as a software engineer, and<CR>he's told me a million horror stories about crunch.
records.en: My dad is a systems engineer at an IT company,<CR>and he's always telling me stories about crunch right before deadlines.

records.jp: その象徴的キーワードがデスマよ
records.en_original: And that last period of crunch just before delivery is called the "death march."
records.en_auxiliary: And that last period of crunch just before delivery is called a "death march."
records.en: The keyword that symbolizes all of that is "death march."

records.jp: よくわからないけど……例えば？
records.en_original: You're still not clearing things up here... Can you give me an example?
records.en_auxiliary: You're still not clearing things up here... Can you give me an example?
records.en: I don't really understand... Could you give me an example?

records.jp: 例えば……例えば……ああ、口に出すのも恐ろしいわ
records.en_original: Example...Example... Ugh, trying to explain it is a nightmare.
records.en_auxiliary: An example? As an example... Ah, even just explaining it is a nightmare.
records.en: For example... For example... Ah, it's too terrifying even to say aloud.

records.jp: やっぱり私もデスマを経験しないと、<CR>良いピアノが弾けないのかしら
records.en_original: But I think that until I experience my own death march, my piano skills will be stuck at this plateau.
records.en_auxiliary: But I think that until I experience my own death march, my piano skills will be stuck at this plateau.
records.en: Maybe I really do need to experience a death march myself<CR>before I can play the piano well.

records.jp: いや、それはなんか違う気がするけど
records.en_original: Somehow I get the feeling that a death march isn't quite as positive as you make it out to be.
records.en_auxiliary: Somehow I get the feeling that a death march isn't quite as positive as you make it out to be.
records.en: No, I feel like that's not quite right.

records.jp: とにかく、デスマが気になるなら、<CR>自分で調べてみるといいわ
records.en_original: If you're curious about death marches, you should look into them for yourself.
records.en_auxiliary: If you're curious about death marches, you should look into them for yourself.
records.en: Anyway, if you're curious about death marches,<CR>you should look them up yourself.

records.jp: 新しい世界が開けること間違いなしだから！
records.en_original: They'll open up a whole new world of possibility for you, I guarantee it!
records.en_auxiliary: They'll open up a whole new world of possibility for you, I guarantee it!
records.en: It'll definitely open up a whole new world for you!
